name: Bob McAdoo
context: A 6'9" big man with a jumper, averaging 34.5 points in 1975 — on a team in Buffalo. Only MJ (twice) has scored at a higher clip since. McAdoo led the league in points, rebounds, and minutes that year and won MVP. Almost nobody talks about it.
tags: League MVP, 3× scoring champ, All-NBA First Team, Buffalo Braves, Hall of Famer

name: Willie Mays
context: The year Mays made "The Catch" — a season so complete it's often overshadowed by the World Series moment itself. He led the NL in batting average AND slugging while playing center field at a level no one matched for a decade.
tags: NL MVP, NL batting title, WS champion, Gold Glove era
